mapper.select: SELECT id AS workplaceId, name AS workplaceName, road_address AS roadAddress, detail_address AS detailAddress, latitude AS latitude, longitude AS longitude, radius_meters AS radiusMeters FROM workplaces WHERE id = #{workplaceId} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id AS workCaseId, employer_id AS employerId, workplace_id AS workplaceId, worker_id AS workerId, status AS status, terms_version AS termsVersion, starts_at AS startsAt, ends_at AS endsAt, agreed_wage AS agreedWage, break_minutes AS breakMinutes, break_paid AS breakPaid FROM work_cases WHERE id = #{workCaseId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_cases (employer_id, worker_id, workplace_id, title, starts_at, ends_at, break_minutes, break_paid, workplace_name, workplace_address, workplace_latitude, workplace_longitude, allowed_radius_meters, agreed_wage, terms_version, status) VALUES (#{employerId}, NULL, #{workplaceId}, #{title}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{breakMinutes}, #{breakPaid}, #{workplaceName}, #{workplaceAddress}, #{workplaceLatitude}, #{workplaceLongitude}, #{allowedRadiusMeters}, #{dailyWage}, 1, 'DRAFT')
mapper.update: UPDATE work_cases SET title = #{title}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, break_minutes = #{breakMinutes}, break_paid = #{breakPaid}, agreed_wage = #{dailyWage}, terms_version = terms_version + 1 WHERE id = #{workCaseId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE work_cases SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{workCaseId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE work_cases SET worker_id = #{workerId}, status = 'ACCEPTED' WHERE id = #{workCaseId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND worker_id IS NULL

SELECT wc.id AS workCaseId, wc.title AS title, wc.starts_at AS startsAt, wc.ends_at AS endsAt, wc.break_minutes AS breakMinutes, wc.break_paid AS breakPaid, wc.agreed_wage AS dailyWage, wc.status AS status, wc.terms_version AS termsVersion, wc.workplace_name AS workplaceName, wc.workplace_address AS workplaceAddress, wc.employer_id AS employerId, wc.worker_id AS workerId, w.name AS workerName FROM work_cases wc LEFT JOIN users w ON w.id = wc.worker_id WHERE wc.id = #{workCaseId}
SELECT status, expected_terms_version AS termsVersion, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM work_invitations WHERE work_case_id = #{workCaseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id AS contractId, d.id AS documentId, d.status AS documentStatus, c.source_terms_version AS sourceTermsVersion, c.accepted_at AS acceptedAt FROM work_contracts c LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.work_case_id = c.work_case_id AND d.document_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT' WHERE c.work_case_id = #{workCaseId}

SELECT status, amount, worker_paid_amount AS workerPaidAmount, owner_refund_amount AS ownerRefundAmount, deduction_base_minutes AS deductionBaseMinutes, late_minutes AS lateMinutes, early_leave_minutes AS earlyLeaveMinutes, calculation_reason AS calculationReason, calculation_version AS calculationVersion, calculated_at AS calculatedAt, due_at AS dueAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM settlements WHERE work_case_id = #{workCaseId}
